import java.util.*;
public class Config { public static String resolve(String key,Map<String,String> env,Map<String,String> file,String fallback){String v=env.get(key);if(v!=null&&!v.isBlank())return v;v=file.get(key);return v!=null&&!v.isBlank()?v:fallback;} }
